request.sql:
SELECT
    c_name,
    c_custkey,
    o_orderkey,
    o_orderdate,
    o_totalprice,
    sum(l_quantity)
FROM
    customer,
    orders,
    lineitem
WHERE
    o_orderkey IN (
        SELECT
            l_orderkey
        FROM
            lineitem
        GROUP BY
            l_orderkey
        HAVING
            sum(l_quantity) > 300)
    AND c_custkey = o_custkey
    AND o_orderkey = l_orderkey
GROUP BY
    c_name,
    c_custkey,
    o_orderkey,
    o_orderdate,
    o_totalprice
ORDER BY
    o_totalprice DESC,
    o_orderdate
LIMIT 100;

result.optimized_plan:

    Project: [c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, SUM(l_quantity)]
      Aggregate: group_by=[c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice], aggs=[SUM(l_quantity)]
        INNER Join
          on: o_orderkey = l_orderkey
          INNER Join
            on: o_custkey = c_custkey
            SEMI Join
              on: o_orderkey = l_orderkey
              Scan: orders [o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_orderstatus, o_totalprice, o_orderdate, o_orderpriority, o_clerk, o_shippriority, o_comment]
                projection: [0, 1, 3, 4]
              Project: [l_orderkey]
                Filter: (SUM(l_quantity) > 300)
                  Aggregate: group_by=[l_orderkey], aggs=[SUM(l_quantity)]
                    Scan: lineitem [l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment]
                      projection: [0, 4]
            Scan: customer [c_custkey, c_name, c_address, c_nationkey, c_phone, c_acctbal, c_mktsegment, c_comment]
              projection: [0, 1]
          Scan: lineitem [l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_linenumber, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax, l_returnflag, l_linestatus, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipinstruct, l_shipmode, l_comment]
            projection: [0, 4]
